# Archived Meta parallel stacks

These files are preserved for lineage only. They were removed from the active production path because they contained one or more competing extraction/storage/RAG implementations, capped/silent-partial extraction behavior, model-coupled source ingestion, legacy schemas, or unbenchmarked enrichment logic.

They are **not** part of frontier extraction certification. No file was deleted; promotion requires an explicit re-audit and migration into the canonical contracts.
